newsitem.title: CANADA: Cowen & Co initiates ARC Intl as strong buy.
newsitem.headline: Cowen & Co initiates ARC Intl as strong buy.

text.p: New York-based Cowen & Co said on Thursday that it initiated coverage of entertainment firm ARC International Corp as a strong buy.

Analyst Paul Marsh also gave the shares of Toronto-based ARC, which trade on the American Stock Exchange, a target price of US$9.00 within a year. On Thursday they traded around US$3-3/4, after rising 1/2, on volume of more than half a million shares.
ARC's 65-percent owned subsidiary Cabletel Communications Corp trades in Toronto. Its stock was last traded on August 27 at C$7.25.
